target.name: AllianzGI Global Equity & Convertible Income Fund

announcement.quote: We are proposing to merge AllianzGI Global Equity & Convertible Income Fund (“NGZ”) into AllianzGI Equity & Convertible Income Fund (“NIE” and, together with NGZ, the “Funds”).

deals.notes: Excerpts show only the proposal (N-14, amendment, 425 proxy fact sheet for a joint meeting on January 14, 2014) and later annual-meeting proxies that do not mention the merger. No excerpt states the outcome. Exchange listing is only implied by a mention of NYSE listing fees, which does not settle it.
